entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these ridiculous cycling shoes I bought. They're a complete waste of money and they've ruined my feet!

I'm very sorry to hear that you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, is it a technical fault with the shoe itself, or is it more a matter of fit and preference?
Are you serious? A 'preference'? They gave me massive blisters after one ride! The fit is awful! This is completely unacceptable for a premium product. I want a full refund, and I want it now!

I understand your frustration completely. Getting blisters is a terrible experience and definitely not what we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your account. I see you've been a VIP member with us for several years, and we really appreciate your loyalty.
Don't try to flatter me. Your loyalty program doesn't fix my feet. Just process the return. This is the worst service I've ever had. I want to speak to your manager!

I can definitely help you with this directly, as my manager would authorize the same solution. Our cycling shoes fall under our 90-day return policy, and since you received them just eight days ago, you are well within the window for a full refund. I can start that process for you immediately.

A refund is the bare minimum! I'm out the time, my training schedule is messed up, and I'm in pain because of these shoes. I'm going to leave a review on every single website about this. This is a joke.

I completely understand, and I want to make this right for you. I've already initiated the full refund. As a sincere apology for the trouble and the painful blisters you've had to deal with, I'm also adding a $25 goodwill credit to your account. You can use that towards a different pair of shoes or any other VeloFit gear in the future.
Fine. A credit and the refund. How do I send these things back? And you better not charge me for shipping.

Of course not. Return shipping is completely free. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the cycling shoes and the cleats back in the original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any local post office. The moment our warehouse scans it, your refund will be processed.
Okay. That's acceptable. Make sure that email arrives.
I've just confirmed it was sent. It should be in your inbox now. The $25 credit is already active on your account as well. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and again, my apologies for the issue with the shoes. We appreciate your business. Have a great day.
